name: Default
shortDescription: Kopia backup server with its web UI for encrypted, deduplicated and compressed snapshots to local or cloud repositories.

alerts.message: Sign in with the KOPIA_SERVER_USERNAME and KOPIA_SERVER_PASSWORD environment values. When you create or connect a repository in the web UI, use the generated KOPIA_PASSWORD as the repository password: the server reopens the repository with it after every restart.
Mounting snapshots as a filesystem is not available, since it needs FUSE and a privileged container. Browsing and restoring snapshots from the web UI works.

Other Kopia clients cannot connect to this deployment as a repository server: that mode uses gRPC, which needs TLS on the Kopia server itself, while this template serves plain HTTP behind the HTTPS proxy. Manage snapshots through the web UI instead.
